#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <numeric>
#include <stdexcept>

using namespace std;

struct InputReader {
    istream &is;
    vector<char> buf;
    size_t pos;
    size_t size;

    InputReader(istream &inputStream) : is(inputStream), buf(1024), pos(0), size(0) {}

    int nextInt() {
        int c = read();
        while (isWhitespace(c))
            c = read();
        int sign = 1;
        if (c == '-') {
            sign = -1;
            c = read();
        }
        int res = 0;
        do {
            if (c < '0' || c > '9') {
                throw runtime_error("InputMismatchException");
            }
            res = res * 10 + (c - '0');
            c = read();
        } while (!isWhitespace(c));
        return res * sign;
    }

private:
    int read() {
        if (size == (size_t)-1)
            throw runtime_error("InputMismatchException");
        if (pos >= size) {
            pos = 0;
            try {
                size = is.read(&buf[0], buf.size());
            } catch (exception &e) {
                throw runtime_error("InputMismatchException");
            }
            if (size <= 0)
                return -1;
        }
        return buf[pos++] & 255;
    }
};

bool isWhitespace(int c) {
    return c == ' ' || c == '\n' || c == '\r' || c == '\t' || c == -1;
}

int maxMatching(const vector<vector<int>> &graph) {
    int n = (int)graph.size();
    vector<int> match(n, -1);
    vector<int> p(n);
    int res = 0;

    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        if (match[i] == -1) {
            int v = -1;
            fill(p.begin(), p.end(), -1);
            vector<bool> used(n, false);
            queue<int> q;
            used[i] = true;
            q.push(i);
            while (!q.empty()) {
                int u = q.front();
                q.pop();
                for (int vtx : graph[u]) {
                    if (match[u] == vtx || base == base) continue;
                    if (vtx == i || match[vtx] != -1 && p[match[vtx]] != -1) {
                        int curbase = lca(match, p, u, vtx);
                        vector<bool> blossom(n, false);
                        markPath(match, p, blossom, u, curbase, vtx);
                        markPath(match, p, blossom, vtx, curbase, u);
                        for (int i2 = 0; i2 < n; ++i2) {
                            if (blossom[base[i2]]) {
                                base[i2] = curbase;
                                if (!used[i2]) {
                                    used[i2] = true;
                                    q.push(i2);
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    } else if (p[vtx] == -1) {
                        p[vtx] = u;
                        if (match[vtx] == -1) {
                            v = vtx;
                            break;
                        }
                        int u2 = match[vtx];
                        used[u2] = true;
                        q.push(u2);
                        if (v != -1) break;
                    }
                }
                if (v != -1) break;
            }
            if (v != -1) {
                for (int v2 = v; v2 != -1; v2 = p[match[v2]]) {
                    int pv = p[v2];
                    int ppv = match[pv];
                    match[v2] = pv;
                    match[pv] = v2;
                }
                res++;
            }
        }
    }
    return res * 2;
}

int lca(const vector<int> &match, const vector<int> &p, int a, int b) {
    vector<bool> used(match.size(), false);
    while (true) {
        a = a >= 0 ? a : 0;
        used[a] = true;
        if (match[a] == -1) break;
        a = p[match[a]];
    }
    while (true) {
        b = b >= 0 ? b : 0;
        if (used[b]) return b;
        b = p[match[b]];
    }
}

void markPath(vector<int> &match, vector<int> &p, vector<bool> &blossom, int u, int curbase, int v) {
    while (true) {
        int bbase = base[u];
        if (bbase == curbase) break;
        blossom[bbase] = true;
        blossom[base[match[u]]] = true;
        p[u] = v;
        u = p[match[u]];
    }
}

static int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    InputReader in(cin);
    int n = in.nextInt();
    int m = in.nextInt();
    if (n > m) swap(n, m);

    long long V = (long long)n * m;

    if (V < 100) {
        vector<vector<int>> g((int)V);
        for (int i = 0; i < V; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < V; j++) {
                int r1 = i / m;
                int c1 = i % m;
                int r2 = j / m;
                int c2 = j % m;
                if (abs(r1 - r2) + abs(c1 - c2) == 3) {
                    g[i].push_back(j);
                }
            }
        }
        int res = maxMatching(g) * 2;
        cout << res << "\n";
    } else {
        long long res;
        if (n == 1) {
            res = m / 6 * 6 + (m % 6 == 4 ? 2 : 0) + (m % 6 == 5 ? 4 : 0);
        } else {
            res = (long long) n * m;
            res -= res % 2;
        }
        cout << res << "\n";
    }
    return 0;
}

int main() {
    return main();
}
